---
description: "Create problem-oriented work items, dependencies, owners, alternatives, and statuses from approved analysis."
name: "Decompose"
agent: "Engineering Orchestrator"
---
If `.agentic/state/` does not exist, bootstrap minimal state files first.

Load `.agentic/state/project-state.md` and create or refine problem-oriented work items in `.agentic/state/dependency-graph.md`.

Decompose by engineering problem, not by technology.

For each item record owner, dependencies, status, alternatives, recommendation, decision required, relevant files, validation, and risks.

Do not invent competition requirements. Stop at consequential decision gates.
